method.geometry: All four flyer models on every current production route at altitude44; finite EnemyPreview current articulated poses; 1 authored-unit sample step plus four wing/rotor phase offsets at corner centres and tangent joins. Conservative transformed part-box versus exact occupied static cuboid BVH; candidate overlaps refined to actual voxel OBB versus cuboid SAT. Terrain and bridges are in the static tree. No GPU, combat, model or browser changes.
method.traffic: All64 finite schedules,120Hz unarmed root samples; current FlightPathMotion for air and PathMotion for ground, speed/HP/altitude profiles from each wave; conservative full-animation horizontal circles, vertical envelopes and all same-wave actor pairs. Negative bounds are candidates, not proof of actual mesh overlap.
method.placements: Frozen five policy witnesses from the pre-flight balance review, every recorded wave and all recorded simultaneous deployments; current production placement.check with critters false. Includes current support, visibility, movement/scenery/route/unit clearance. Does not rerun wildlife habitat relocation or combat.

limits: Geometry and traffic are finite samples, not continuous collision proofs.
The four flyer cross-zone cases are stress cases; report distinguishes species actually scheduled in each level.
Natural wing/rotor phases are sampled along the entire route; three additional offsets at bends do not exhaust all independent phases.
Unarmed traffic has no missile impact displacement.
Legal frozen placements establish retained availability, not retained campaign victory or optimality.
